SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(INVESTED_AMOUNT AS REAL)), 0) FROM POSITIONS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(ORDER_AMOUNT AS REAL)), 0) FROM ORDERS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')

SELECT ID FROM POSITIONS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, FLAT_STARTED_DATE AS flatStartedDate, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, FLAT_STARTED_DATE AS flatStartedDate, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y' AND STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY ID ASC

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y' AND STATUS = 'BLACK' ORDER BY ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POSITIONS ( STOCK_CODE, STOCK_NAME, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE, PURCHASE_QUANTITY, INVESTED_AMOUNT, CURRENT_PRICE, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT, PROFIT_RATE, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE, REFERENCE_PRICE, HIGHEST_PRICE, LOWEST_PRICE, HOLDING_QUANTITY, RETURN_RATE, LAST_EVALUATED_AT, FLAT_STARTED_DATE, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{status}, #{purchasePrice}, #{purchaseQuantity}, #{investedAmount}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentValuationAmount}, #{profitRate}, #{lastEvaluatedPrice}, #{statusReferencePrice}, #{grayTradingDays}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{referencePrice}, #{highestPrice}, #{lowestPrice}, #{holdingQuantity}, #{returnRate}, #{lastEvaluatedAt}, null, 'Y', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POSITIONS SET STOCK_NAME = #{stockName}, PURCHASE_PRICE = #{purchasePrice}, PURCHASE_QUANTITY = #{purchaseQuantity}, INVESTED_AMOUNT = #{investedAmount}, CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT = #{currentValuationAmount}, PROFIT_RATE = #{profitRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE = #{lastEvaluatedPrice}, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE = COALESCE(STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE, #{statusReferencePrice}), AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE = #{averageBuyPrice}, REFERENCE_PRICE = COALESCE(REFERENCE_PRICE, #{referencePrice}), HIGHEST_PRICE = MAX(CAST(COALESCE(HIGHEST_PRICE, #{highestPrice}) AS REAL), CAST(#{highestPrice} AS REAL)), LOWEST_PRICE = MIN(CAST(COALESCE(LOWEST_PRICE, #{lowestPrice}) AS REAL), CAST(#{lowestPrice} AS REAL)), HOLDING_QUANTITY = #{holdingQuantity}, RETURN_RATE = #{returnRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_AT = #{lastEvaluatedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{positionId}

UPDATE POSITIONS SET STATUS = #{status}, CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT = #{currentValuationAmount}, PROFIT_RATE = #{profitRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE = #{lastEvaluatedPrice}, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE = #{statusReferencePrice}, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE = #{grayEnteredDate}, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS = #{grayTradingDays}, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE = #{averageBuyPrice}, REFERENCE_PRICE = #{referencePrice}, HIGHEST_PRICE = #{highestPrice}, LOWEST_PRICE = #{lowestPrice}, HOLDING_QUANTITY = #{holdingQuantity}, RETURN_RATE = #{returnRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_AT = #{lastEvaluatedAt}, FLAT_STARTED_DATE = #{flatStartedDate}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{positionId} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'

UPDATE POSITIONS SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', ACTIVE = 'N', CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT = #{currentValuationAmount}, PROFIT_RATE = #{profitRate}, RETURN_RATE = #{returnRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_AT = #{closedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{closedAt} WHERE ID = #{positionId} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_STATUS FROM ORDERS WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = #{idempotencyKey} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_QUANTITY AS orderQuantity, ORDER_PRICE AS orderPrice, ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO AS brokerOrderOrgNo, BROKER_STATUS AS brokerStatus, LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT AS lastBrokerStatusCheckedAt, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY AS idempotencyKey, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND (ORDER_STATUS = 'DRY_RUN' OR BROKER_STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')) ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_QUANTITY AS orderQuantity, ORDER_PRICE AS orderPrice, ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO AS brokerOrderOrgNo, BROKER_STATUS AS brokerStatus, LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT AS lastBrokerStatusCheckedAt, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY AS idempotencyKey, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND (ORDER_STATUS = 'DRY_RUN' OR BROKER_STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')) ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_TYPE AS orderType, ORDER_QUANTITY AS orderQuantity, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO AS brokerOrderOrgNo, BROKER_STATUS AS brokerStatus FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND BROKER_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BROKER_ORDER_ID) != '' ORDER BY ID
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET BROKER_ORDER_ID = #{brokerOrderId}, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO = #{brokerOrderOrgNo}, ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, BROKER_STATUS = #{brokerStatus}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = #{idempotencyKey}

UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, BROKER_STATUS = #{brokerStatus}, FILLED_QUANTITY = COALESCE(#{filledQuantity}, FILLED_QUANTITY), REMAINING_QUANTITY = COALESCE(#{remainingQuantity}, REMAINING_QUANTITY), FILLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'FILLED' THEN COALESCE(FILLED_AT, #{checkedAt}) ELSE FILLED_AT END, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT = #{checkedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{checkedAt} WHERE BROKER_ORDER_ID = #{brokerOrderId} AND (#{brokerOrderOrgNo} IS NULL OR BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO = #{brokerOrderOrgNo} OR BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO IS NULL) AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( BROKER_ORDER_ID, STOCK_CODE, ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_QUANTITY, ORDER_PRICE, ORDER_AMOUNT, ORDER_STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, REQUESTED_AT, UPDATED_AT, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, DECISION_CYCLE_ID, INSTANCE_ID, MASKED_ACCOUNT, SKIP_REASON, EXIT_REASON, DRY_RUN, CURRENT_PRICE, CURRENT_PRICE_AT ,BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO ) VALUES ( #{brokerOrderId}, #{stockCode}, #{orderType}, #{orderQuantity}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderStatus}, 0, #{errorMessage}, #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{decisionCycleId}, #{instanceId}, #{maskedAccount}, #{skipReason}, #{exitReason}, #{dryRun}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentPriceAt} ,#{brokerOrderOrgNo} )
INSERT INTO SCHEDULER_EXECUTION ( SCHEDULER_TYPE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, EXECUTION_STATUS, MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{schedulerType}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{executionStatus}, #{message} )
INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( EVENT_TYPE, STOCK_CODE, details, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{stockCode}, #{details}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO TRADE_LIFECYCLE_HISTORY ( LIFECYCLE_ID, EVENT_TYPE, PREVIOUS_STATE, NEW_STATE, CURRENT_PRICE, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE, REFERENCE_PRICE, HIGHEST_PRICE, LOWEST_PRICE, HOLDING_QUANTITY, RETURN_RATE, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS, REASON, ORDER_ID, EXECUTION_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, OCCURRED_AT ) VALUES ( #{lifecycleId}, #{eventType}, #{previousState}, #{newState}, #{currentPrice}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{referencePrice}, #{highestPrice}, #{lowestPrice}, #{holdingQuantity}, #{returnRate}, #{grayTradingDays}, #{reason}, #{orderId}, #{executionId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{occurredAt} )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOMESTIC_STOCK_MASTER WHERE AND ACTIVE = 'Y' AND TRADABLE = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOMESTIC_STOCK_MASTER ( SYMBOL, STOCK_NAME, MARKET_CODE, STANDARD_CODE, SECURITY_GROUP_CODE, ETP, SPAC, TRADABLE, ACTIVE, LAST_PRICE, MARKET_CAP, TRADING_VOLUME, EXCLUDED_REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, LAST_SYNCED_AT ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{stockName}, #{marketCode}, #{standardCode}, #{securityGroupCode}, CASE WHEN #{etp} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{spac} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{tradable} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{active} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{lastPrice}, #{marketCap}, #{tradingVolume}, #{excludedReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastSyncedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(SYMBOL, MARKET_CODE) DO UPDATE SET STOCK_NAME = excluded.STOCK_NAME, STANDARD_CODE = excluded.STANDARD_CODE, SECURITY_GROUP_CODE = excluded.SECURITY_GROUP_CODE, ETP = excluded.ETP, SPAC = excluded.SPAC, TRADABLE = excluded.TRADABLE, ACTIVE = excluded.ACTIVE, LAST_PRICE = excluded.LAST_PRICE, MARKET_CAP = excluded.MARKET_CAP, TRADING_VOLUME = excluded.TRADING_VOLUME, EXCLUDED_REASON = excluded.EXCLUDED_REASON, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT, LAST_SYNCED_AT = excluded.LAST_SYNCED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT m.ID, m.SYMBOL, m.STOCK_NAME AS stockName, m.MARKET_CODE AS marketCode, m.SECURITY_GROUP_CODE AS securityGroupCode, m.ETP, m.SPAC, CAST(COALESCE(m.LAST_PRICE, '0') AS TEXT) AS lastPrice, CAST(COALESCE(m.MARKET_CAP, '0') AS TEXT) AS marketCap, CAST(COALESCE(m.TRADING_VOLUME, '0') AS TEXT) AS tradingVolume, m.LAST_SELECTED_AT AS lastSelectedAt, m.LAST_BUY_ATTEMPT_AT AS lastBuyAttemptAt, m.LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT AS lastBuySuccessAt, m.RETRY_AFTER AS retryAfter, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ), 0) AS completedBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS pendingBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS r WHERE r.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND r.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND r.ORDER_STATUS = 'ORDERING' ), 0) AS reservedBuyCount, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CAST(COALESCE(p.INVESTED_AMOUNT, '0') AS REAL)) FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ), 0) AS TEXT) AS totalInvestedAmount, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CAST(COALESCE(o.ORDER_AMOUNT, '0') AS REAL)) FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS TEXT) AS pendingInvestmentAmount FROM DOMESTIC_STOCK_MASTER m WHERE AND m.ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.TRADABLE = 'Y' AND m.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.SYMBOL) != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOMESTIC_STOCK_DASHBOARD ( SYMBOL, MARKET_CODE, RANK_NO, STOCK_NAME, CANDIDATE_SCORE, PURCHASE_ZONE, DASHBOARD_STATUS, LAST_PRICE, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT, PENDING_BUY_COUNT, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON, LAST_SELECTED_AT, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT, RETRY_AFTER, EVALUATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{marketCode}, #{rankNo}, #{stockName}, #{candidateScore}, #{purchaseZone}, #{dashboardStatus}, #{lastPrice}, #{completedBuyCount}, #{pendingBuyCount}, #{reservedBuyCount}, #{currentDuplicateCount}, #{maximumDuplicateCount}, #{remainingDuplicateCount}, #{totalInvestedAmount}, #{pendingInvestmentAmount}, CASE WHEN #{purchasable} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{exclusionReason}, #{lastSelectedAt}, #{lastBuySuccessAt}, #{retryAfter}, #{evaluatedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(SYMBOL, MARKET_CODE) DO UPDATE SET RANK_NO = excluded.RANK_NO, STOCK_NAME = excluded.STOCK_NAME, CANDIDATE_SCORE = excluded.CANDIDATE_SCORE, PURCHASE_ZONE = excluded.PURCHASE_ZONE, DASHBOARD_STATUS = excluded.DASHBOARD_STATUS, LAST_PRICE = excluded.LAST_PRICE, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT = excluded.COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT, PENDING_BUY_COUNT = excluded.PENDING_BUY_COUNT, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT = excluded.RESERVED_BUY_COUNT, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT = excluded.TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT = excluded.PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, PURCHASABLE = excluded.PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON = excluded.EXCLUSION_REASON, LAST_SELECTED_AT = excluded.LAST_SELECTED_AT, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT = excluded.LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT, RETRY_AFTER = excluded.RETRY_AFTER, EVALUATED_AT = excluded.EVALUATED_AT, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DOMESTIC_STOCK_DASHBOARD WHERE (#{marketCode} = 'ALL' OR MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode}) AND EVALUATED_AT != #{evaluatedAt} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = DOMESTIC_STOCK_DASHBOARD.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = DOMESTIC_STOCK_DASHBOARD.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') )
mapper.select: SELECT RANK_NO AS rankNo, SYMBOL, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, MARKET_CODE AS marketCode, CANDIDATE_SCORE AS candidateScore, PURCHASE_ZONE AS purchaseZone, DASHBOARD_STATUS AS dashboardStatus, LAST_PRICE AS lastPrice, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT AS completedBuyCount, PENDING_BUY_COUNT AS pendingBuyCount, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT AS reservedBuyCount, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS currentDuplicateCount, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS maximumDuplicateCount, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS remainingDuplicateCount, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT AS totalInvestedAmount, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT AS pendingInvestmentAmount, CASE WHEN PURCHASABLE = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON AS exclusionReason, LAST_SELECTED_AT AS lastSelectedAt, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT AS lastBuySuccessAt, RETRY_AFTER AS retryAfter, EVALUATED_AT AS evaluatedAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM DOMESTIC_STOCK_DASHBOARD WHERE (#{marketCode} = 'ALL' OR MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode}) ORDER BY RANK_NO ASC, SYMBOL ASC

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y'), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')), 0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OVERSEAS_STOCK_MASTER ( SYMBOL, STOCK_NAME, EXCHANGE_CODE, PRICE_EXCHANGE_CODE, CURRENCY_CODE, SECURITY_TYPE, TRADABLE, ACTIVE, FRACTIONAL_TRADABLE, LAST_PRICE, MARKET_CAP, TRADING_VOLUME, EXCLUDED_REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, LAST_SYNCED_AT ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{stockName}, #{exchangeCode}, #{priceExchangeCode}, #{currencyCode}, #{securityType}, CASE WHEN #{tradable} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{active} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{fractionalTradable}, #{lastPrice}, #{marketCap}, #{tradingVolume}, #{excludedReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastSyncedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(SYMBOL, EXCHANGE_CODE) DO UPDATE SET STOCK_NAME = excluded.STOCK_NAME, PRICE_EXCHANGE_CODE = excluded.PRICE_EXCHANGE_CODE, CURRENCY_CODE = excluded.CURRENCY_CODE, SECURITY_TYPE = excluded.SECURITY_TYPE, TRADABLE = excluded.TRADABLE, ACTIVE = excluded.ACTIVE, LAST_PRICE = excluded.LAST_PRICE, MARKET_CAP = excluded.MARKET_CAP, TRADING_VOLUME = excluded.TRADING_VOLUME, EXCLUDED_REASON = excluded.EXCLUDED_REASON, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT, LAST_SYNCED_AT = excluded.LAST_SYNCED_AT

lastKisResponseMessage, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ), 0) AS completedBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o WHERE WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS TEXT) AS pendingInvestmentAmount FROM OVERSEAS_STOCK_MASTER m WHERE m.EXCHANGE_CODE = #{exchangeCode} AND m.PRICE_EXCHANGE_CODE = #{priceExchangeCode} AND m.CURRENCY_CODE = #{currencyCode} AND m.ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.TRADABLE = 'Y' AND m.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.SYMBOL) != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OVERSEAS_STOCK_DASHBOARD ( SYMBOL, EXCHANGE_CODE, RANK_NO, STOCK_NAME, CANDIDATE_SCORE, PURCHASE_ZONE, DASHBOARD_STATUS, LAST_PRICE, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT, PENDING_BUY_COUNT, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON, LAST_SELECTED_AT, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT, RETRY_AFTER, EVALUATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{rankNo}, #{stockName}, #{candidateScore}, #{purchaseZone}, #{dashboardStatus}, #{lastPrice}, #{completedBuyCount}, #{pendingBuyCount}, #{reservedBuyCount}, #{currentDuplicateCount}, #{maximumDuplicateCount}, #{remainingDuplicateCount}, #{totalInvestedAmount}, #{pendingInvestmentAmount}, CASE WHEN #{purchasable} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{exclusionReason}, #{lastSelectedAt}, #{lastBuySuccessAt}, #{retryAfter}, #{evaluatedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(SYMBOL, EXCHANGE_CODE) DO UPDATE SET RANK_NO = excluded.RANK_NO, STOCK_NAME = excluded.STOCK_NAME, CANDIDATE_SCORE = excluded.CANDIDATE_SCORE, PURCHASE_ZONE = excluded.PURCHASE_ZONE, DASHBOARD_STATUS = excluded.DASHBOARD_STATUS, LAST_PRICE = excluded.LAST_PRICE, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT = excluded.COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT, PENDING_BUY_COUNT = excluded.PENDING_BUY_COUNT, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT = excluded.RESERVED_BUY_COUNT, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT = excluded.TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT = excluded.PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, PURCHASABLE = excluded.PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON = excluded.EXCLUSION_REASON, LAST_SELECTED_AT = excluded.LAST_SELECTED_AT, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT = excluded.LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT, RETRY_AFTER = excluded.RETRY_AFTER, EVALUATED_AT = excluded.EVALUATED_AT, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OVERSEAS_STOCK_DASHBOARD WHERE EXCHANGE_CODE = #{exchangeCode} AND EVALUATED_AT != #{evaluatedAt} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = OVERSEAS_STOCK_DASHBOARD.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = OVERSEAS_STOCK_DASHBOARD.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') )
mapper.select: SELECT RANK_NO AS rankNo, SYMBOL, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, EXCHANGE_CODE AS exchangeCode, CANDIDATE_SCORE AS candidateScore, PURCHASE_ZONE AS purchaseZone, DASHBOARD_STATUS AS dashboardStatus, LAST_PRICE AS lastPrice, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT AS completedBuyCount, PENDING_BUY_COUNT AS pendingBuyCount, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT AS reservedBuyCount, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS currentDuplicateCount, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS maximumDuplicateCount, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS remainingDuplicateCount, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT AS totalInvestedAmount, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT AS pendingInvestmentAmount, CASE WHEN PURCHASABLE = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON AS exclusionReason, LAST_SELECTED_AT AS lastSelectedAt, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT AS lastBuySuccessAt, RETRY_AFTER AS retryAfter, EVALUATED_AT AS evaluatedAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OVERSEAS_STOCK_DASHBOARD WHERE EXCHANGE_CODE = #{exchangeCode} ORDER BY RANK_NO ASC, SYMBOL ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE OVERSEAS_STOCK_MASTER SET FRACTIONAL_TRADABLE = 'YES', FRACTIONAL_VERIFIED_AT = #{verifiedAt}, FRACTIONAL_VERIFICATION_SOURCE = #{source}, LAST_KIS_RESPONSE_CODE = #{responseCode}, LAST_KIS_RESPONSE_MESSAGE = #{responseMessage}, RETRY_AFTER = NULL, EXCLUDED_REASON = NULL, UPDATED_AT = #{verifiedAt} WHERE SYMBOL = #{symbol} AND EXCHANGE_CODE = #{exchangeCode}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y'), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')), 0)
